last_quote: What is growing here may simply not be ready to be seen yet.
Where you are going may be less a place than a harvest still ripening.
Where your way divides, one path may already have fruit under it, unseen until you turn the earth.
This may be a moment where what you want and what has ripened stand apart.
It may be that the turning is near, though not yet ready to be turned.
Your path may be one where the ground is set and the waiting is the harder part.
Your direction may be sound, only not yet ripe.
Where your way divides, this may be the point where an old effort is ready to be counted.
What waits unseen, Kuky, may be nearly ready, needing the moment more than the effort.
What is unseen here, Kuky, may be a thing already ripe, needing only the day that lets it be gathered.
Where you are going may be less a place chosen than a season not yet ripe.
What waits unseen, Kuky, may be a readiness that has not yet found its afternoon.
Here in the lengthening light, this may be a bond still ripening, not yet what it will become.
This may be a moment, Kuky, when the doing and the timing have finally come to the same ground.
This may be a moment where what you have looks too little to choose on.
This may be work that is closer to its turn than the surface shows.
What looks like nothing moving in you may be dough taking its slow shape underneath.
This may be a slow rising in you, given time you did not think you were spending.
